1.name: The Crowning Glory
1.description: Crushed San Marzano tomatoes, fresh buffalo mozzarella, and fresh basil leaves, finished with extra virgin olive oil.

2.name: The Glorified Pepperoni
2.description: Our signature red sauce and mozzarella, loaded with premium pepperoni slices that crisp up in the oven.

3.name: The Majestic Tapestry
3.description: Traditional red sauce, mozzarella, sliced mushrooms, marinated artichoke hearts, smoked ham, and black olives.

4.name: The Halo White
4.description: No tomato sauce. An aromatic base of garlic-infused olive oil, dollops of creamy ricotta cheese, and melted mozzarella.

5.name: The Grand Quartet
5.description: A rich, white base blending four distinct cheeses: mozzarella, sharp gorgonzola blue cheese, fontina, and parmesan.

6.name: The Sovereign Feast
6.description: A hearty meat base of seasoned minced beef, smoky streaky bacon, pepperoni, and Italian sausage over mozzarella.

7.name: The Garden Splendour
7.description: A vibrant vegetarian mix of sweet bell peppers, red onions, mushrooms, sweetcorn, and cherry tomatoes on a herb-tomato base.

8.name: The Imperial Tikka
8.description: A rich, mildly spiced tikka gravy base topped with your choice of marinated chicken breast or paneer cubes, red onions, and green chilies.
